text: PayPal Security Alert: we noticed unusual activity on your account. Your account has been limited. Verify your identity within 24 hours to restore access: https://paypa1-secure-login.xyz/verify
PayPal: a payment of $349.99 was attempted from a new device. If this wasn't you, secure your account now and confirm your login details at the link below.

Alerte de sécurité PayPal : activité inhabituelle détectée sur votre compte. Votre compte est temporairement limité. Vérifiez votre identité et confirmez vos informations de connexion dans les 24 heures.
Aviso de PayPal: hemos detectado un inicio de sesión sospechoso. Su cuenta ha sido suspendida. Inicie sesión y verifique su cuenta ahora para evitar el cierre permanente.
PayPal Sicherheitshinweis: Ihr Konto wurde eingeschränkt. Bitte bestätigen Sie Ihre Identität und aktualisieren Sie Ihre Anmeldedaten, um den Zugriff wiederherzustellen.
Microsoft 365 support: your password expires today. Sign in to keep your mailbox active and verify your account. Failure to act will suspend email access. https://rnicrosoft-support.top/office
Microsoft account security code request. Someone tried to sign in from an unknown location. Confirm it was you or reset your password immediately.
Suporte da Microsoft: sua senha expira hoje. Entre na sua conta e verifique seus dados para não perder o acesso ao e-mail.
微软账户安全提醒：您的账户存在异常登录，请立即登录并验证您的身份，否则账户将被冻结。
RBC Royal Bank: your online banking access has been locked for your protection. Sign in to verify your account and unlock it. https://rbc-royalbank-signin.online
Banque Royale : votre accès aux services bancaires en ligne est verrouillé. Connectez-vous pour vérifier votre compte et le débloquer.
RBC alert: Interac e-Transfer deposit pending. Sign in securely to accept the transfer and confirm your account details.
Coinbase: withdrawal request received. If you did not authorize this, verify your account immediately to freeze your wallet. https://coinbase.com.verify-account.icu
Coinbase: se solicitó un retiro desde su cuenta. Si no fue usted, verifique su cuenta de inmediato para proteger sus fondos.
Warning: fake MetaMask wallet recovery site asking for your secret recovery phrase. Never enter your seed phrase on a website. Reported domain metamask-wallet-recovery.site.
MetaMask security notice: your wallet must be validated or it will be suspended. Import your secret recovery phrase to verify ownership.
Phantom wallet airdrop: you are eligible for a token airdrop. Connect your wallet to claim before the snapshot ends. Limited time.
Netflix billing problem: your payment method was declined and your membership will be cancelled. Update your billing information now to keep watching.
Netflix Zahlungsproblem: Ihre Zahlung wurde abgelehnt. Aktualisieren Sie Ihre Zahlungsinformationen, sonst wird Ihr Abonnement gekündigt.
Shopify billing notice: your store subscription payment failed. Update your billing details and confirm your login to avoid store suspension.
Community report: phishing kit impersonating PayPal, collects email and password then card number. Hosted on a newly registered .top domain, same certificate issuer as several other lookalikes.
Phishing kit targeting Apple ID holders: fake iCloud storage full notice with a login form that harvests Apple ID and password.
Amazon: your order could not be delivered. Confirm your address and payment details to reschedule delivery.
